hero.headline: Frequently asked questions
hero.intro: Twenty years of Dubai property knowledge, distilled into clear answers. If your question isn't here, just ask.

items.q: Who is Tahir Majithia, and why should I trust him for Dubai property investments?
items.a: Tahir Majithia is a recognised authority in Dubai real estate with over 20 years of experience, specialising in exclusive, concierge-level advisory for investors at all levels.

items.q: What types of properties does Tahir Majithia specialise in?
items.a: Tahir offers a full range of properties, including luxury penthouses, villas, off-plan investments, move-in-ready homes, and commercial real estate.

items.q: Is now a good time to invest in Dubai real estate?
items.a: Dubai's real estate market is experiencing strong growth, with high rental yields, tax-free benefits, and increasing foreign investor interest. Tahir provides data-driven insights to guide the best investment timing.

items.q: How does the buying process work for international investors?
items.a: The process includes selecting a property, signing a Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA), making a deposit, obtaining approvals, completing payments, and registering with the Dubai Land Department.

items.q: What are the key benefits of investing in Dubai real estate?
items.a: Benefits include high rental returns, no property taxes, investor-friendly regulations, and residency visa eligibility for property owners.

items.q: What is the minimum investment required to buy property in Dubai?
items.a: The minimum investment varies by property type and location, but off-plan projects start at around $150,000, while luxury properties range from $500,000 to several million dollars.

items.q: Can I buy property in Dubai with cryptocurrency?
items.a: Yes. Tahir offers expertise in crypto-based real estate transactions, ensuring a secure and compliant process.

items.q: Are there any financing options for foreign investors?
items.a: Yes. Some banks and financial institutions offer mortgage options for non-residents, typically requiring a 40% down payment.

items.q: What are the expected returns on investment (ROI) in Dubai?
items.a: Rental yields range from 6–10%, depending on location and property type, making Dubai one of the most lucrative real estate markets globally.

items.q: Are there additional costs besides the property price?
items.a: Additional costs include a 4% Dubai Land Department fee, a 2% agency fee (only applicable to re-sale / secondary market transactions), and possible service charges for maintenance.

items.q: How easy is it to sell property in Dubai?
items.a: Dubai has a liquid real estate market with high demand from international buyers. Tahir's network ensures smooth and profitable sales.

items.q: Are there any taxes on selling property in Dubai?
items.a: No capital gains tax or inheritance tax applies, but transaction fees may apply.

items.q: How long does it take to complete a property sale in Dubai?
items.a: Depending on the property type and buyer financing, sales can take anywhere from a few weeks to a few months.

items.q: Can property investment in Dubai help me get a residency visa?
items.a: Yes. Investors purchasing properties worth AED 750,000 or more may qualify for a residency visa, with long-term visas available for higher-value investments.

items.q: Are there restrictions on foreign ownership in Dubai?
items.a: Foreigners can buy property in designated freehold areas with full ownership rights.
